method: Repository-wide search of docs/validation/, core/platform/validation_record.json (every committed version), docs/validation/physical-module-baseline.json, campaign and release evidence, every branch on origin, and the full git history including deleted files. No physical device was opened, written, erased, acquired or restored.

states.PHYSICALLY VALIDATED: A recorded run on real hardware, with its evidence in the repository.
states.SOFTWARE/SYNTHETIC ONLY: Tested against fixtures, loop devices or synthetic images; the code is not claimed to exist on real media paths.
states.SUPPORTED BUT NOT PHYSICALLY VALIDATED: The code path exists, is offered by the app and is fixture-tested; no recorded run on real hardware.
states.UNSUPPORTED / NOT IMPLEMENTED: No code performs it. The app refuses with the reason.
states.EVIDENCE MISSING: A physical run is reported by the owner but no record of it exists in the repository.

validation_record_hardware_section.history: Empty in every committed version, from fab4986 (2026-09-21) to be9b346 (2026-09-28). hardware_passed() therefore returns False for every feature, and the app shows firmware Purge and HPA/DCO unlock as UNVERIFIED.

capabilities.implementation: core/device/capabilities.py selects; core/erase/drive.py dispatches; core/platform/linux.py:242 gates on hardware_passed('linux', 'whole_drive_purge')
capabilities.notes: The only physical drive on record (TOSHIBA TransMemory 7.76 GB, USB) probed ata_security_erase: false, ata_sanitize_ops: [], is_sed_opal: false (docs/validation/hardware.md, Phase A capability probe). No firmware Purge could run on it.

capabilities.capability: NVMe format / crypto erase (and Opal crypto erase)

capabilities.notes: On the TransMemory stick (2026-09-05) the probe was skipped behind the USB bridge by design: HPA/DCO 'Not probed - probe_failed' (docs/validation/hardware.md A.1). Detection is fixture-tested (tests/erase/test_hidden_area_phases.py).

capabilities.capability: Backup creation and verification before a destructive write
capabilities.app_state: enforced gate (workflow BACKUP REQUIRED -> BACKUP VERIFIED)
capabilities.implementation: core/authorization.py; api workflow backup gate; scripts/media_benchmark.py verify_backup
capabilities.notes: The gate hashes and sizes an image the operator supplies. It does not create the image, and nothing proves the image is a copy of the device. Tests: tests/test_authorization_binding.py, tests/scripts/test_media_benchmark*.py. physical-module-baseline.json (2026-09-24) is a read-only snapshot of the stick, not a backup.
